briefings.title: Reed Hastings on Life After Netflix and the Next Wave of AI | The CEO Signal
briefings.tldr: Reed Hastings reflects on his transition out of Netflix after 29 years, his new role turning around Powder Mountain in Utah, and why he views the exponential growth of AI as a workforce-doubling opportunity for companies willing to embrace creative destruction.

briefings.title: Reed Hastings on Netflix, Powder Mountain, Anthropic's AI warning | Full interview
briefings.tldr: Netflix co-founder Reed Hastings reflects on his transition from a 25-year "marriage" with Netflix to his new "rebound" venture, Powder Mountain, while offering insights into his radical leadership philosophy, the future of AI in education, and the strategic evolution of the streaming industry.

briefings.title: Netflix Co-CEO Ted Sarandos testifies before Senate on Netflix-Warner Bros. deal — 2/3/2026

people.name: Bruce Campbell
people.role: Chief Revenue and Strategy Officer, Warner Bros. Discovery

briefings.tldr: The Senate Antitrust Subcommittee convened to scrutinize Netflix's proposed $83 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, with senators raising significant concerns about market concentration, potential harm to consumers and creative labor, and ideological content bias, while company executives defended the deal as pro-consumer, pro-growth, and beneficial for the American entertainment industry.
